description: Look up a known advisory ID or alias, or an exact ecosystem and package name in the frozen OSV collection. Supply advisory_id OR both ecosystem and package; cursor continues the same lookup. Returns at most 20 concise source matches and route IDs for preview_evidence_answer. Source capture dates and withdrawals are explicit. Full previews include separately dated EPSS/KEV matches and explicit fix boundaries; scores are not asset-risk assessments. No results never mean safe. No range solving, current scanning, independent verification or payment. Free and read-only.

advisory_id.description: Known advisory ID or alias, 1–180 characters. Supply this OR both ecosystem and package; uses frozen source captures.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from this same lookup, 1–512 characters. Retain the original ID or ecosystem/package arguments; omit on the first page.

ecosystem.description: Exact OSV ecosystem label, 1–40 characters, paired with package. No cross-ecosystem inference.

package.description: Exact package name within ecosystem, 1–512 characters. Not a package URL, version range or dependency scan.

name: find_package_advisories
title: Find frozen package advisory sources
